Overview.Name: Mandala anitha
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2 eggs) & paneer cubes (60 g)
Option 2: RICE RAWA upma (small) & paneer cubes (60 g)
Option 3: Puffed rice (2 cups) & egg bhurji (2 eggs) (lighter option)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (100 g paneer) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & spinach curry
Option 3: Paneer curry (100 g paneer) & vegetable curry & salad (lighter option)
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) & dal (light) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Egg bhurji (2 eggs) & cucumber salad
Option 3: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & paneer cubes (60 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid gluten foods completely and focus more on rice, eggs, paneer and vegetables.
Since thyroid is present, keep meal timings consistent and avoid skipping meals.
Sweet cravings during social gatherings can be managed by eating eggs or dal first.
Because overeating happens once you start, serve one fixed portion and eat slowly.
Simple home style cooking will help you stay consistent without stress.
